portal.fundingReceivedDef: Approved client transfers into project funds held by the studio.
portal.companyPaidCostDef: What the studio paid from project funds to suppliers and labour, after review.
portal.remainingDef: Funding received − company-paid costs − calculated management fees. Not a bank balance.
portal.directPurchasesDef: Purchases the client paid directly; part of project cost but not taken from studio-held funds.
portal.managementFeesDef: The agreed fee percentage applied to eligible approved costs.
portal.recordedProjectCostDef: Company costs + direct purchases + calculated management fees.
portal.overallUnavailableReason: Stage weights are not set and no stage progress has been published yet.
portal.categoryBasis: Cost basis: company costs + direct purchases, excluding management fees.
portal.budgetMissing: No approved budget for this project, so no budget comparison is shown.
portal.quality_progress_not_recorded: Stage progress has not been recorded yet.
portal.quality_cash_history_incomplete: Fee withdrawal history is incomplete, so no cash movement balance is shown.
